mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the air sacs and capillaries was most worthwhile because it showed oxygen and carbon dioxide crossing in opposite directions while air and blood stay separate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the branching airways was clear but predictable, and it was the only offered combination at that point.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that gases can cross between air and blood without the air bubbling into the blood.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained what the parts were for.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter to see how the lungs connect with the rest of the body. The gas-exchange picture made me curious.
